title: Inspect history loading, recovery and bounded record reading
description: A developer uses the actual CampaignHistory component with the existing reducer-derived lab records. Browser time controls presentation only; these deterministic specimens are not network recovery, recipient authorization, pagination or hosted service evidence. The live history story remains separate.

steps.description: Freeze browser playback only; no authenticated campaign, remote reads or service clock are replaced.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Open the history scenario and inspect pending loading without invented records.
steps.acknowledgement: Both motion panes report “Loading campaign records…” identically.
verifications: No records are presented as recovered while loading or interrupted.
Latest is disabled while the return control remains available.
The labeled history specimen and footer remain contained while records scroll in their own bounded region.
